composing_units: Panzer Regiment 3; Panzergrenadier Regiment 2; Panzergrenadier Regiment 304
current_activity: marching from Amiens toward the battle area
notes: Began move from Amiens to the battle area night of 9-10 June; on 10 June strung out between Amiens and Alencon, not expected in strength until 13 June; arrived without tanks at first.
Counter-attacked 13 June between Cahagnes and Villers-Bocage with two infantry regiments and two artillery battalions but no tanks.
